answer_1.quote: We introduce In-sightAgent, the first automated system capable of generating high-quality systematic reviews.
datasets: 15 existing systematic reviews in the biomedical domain

answer_2.quote: We measure how accurately can InsightAgent identify relevant studies in the corpus during record screening. We report precision, recall and F1 scores.

answer_4.quote: We invite 9 medical experts with prior experience in publishing systematic reviews to participate in the evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: Each generated report is independently scored by two experts on multiple dimensions, such as comprehensiveness and writing quality, totaling 100 points. The rubric is collaboratively defined by domain experts, with peer-reviewed human systematic reviews as the ground truth (100 points).
